name: VLM-SubtleBench
description: VLM-SubtleBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models on subtle comparative reasoning across ten difference types, including attribute, emotion, temporal, and spatial differences. It spans diverse domains such as industrial, aerial, and medical imagery to assess fine-grained visual reasoning.
typical_sota_score: ≈55–75% (top recent multimodal models report accuracy in the mid-range for subtle comparative reasoning; exact values vary by split and difference-type)
reputation: A new specialized benchmark that has not yet seen broad community adoption, but is relevant for probing fine-grained visual comparison abilities in VLMs.
notes: Covers subtle differences in images beyond large salient changes; reveals systematic gaps between model and human performance.
